requirement_source: IAM authentication boundary; RES-006; QRY-001; docs/05 HTTP 401

role: anonymous API caller; existing authenticated Edge test/admin session
preconditions: local UI and API listening; no credential export
api_expected: HTTP 401 with stable authentication response and no data-source names
browser_action: Use visible navigation to open 查询控制台 and inspect the data-source selector

risk: Authentication status mapping and resource discovery leakage

journey: Execute a bounded read-only constant query
preconditions: an ACTIVE non-production test data source is visible; SELECT 1 has no business-table reference
api_action: Browser owns the authenticated execution; no non-secret authenticated shell harness is available
api_expected: NOT RUN: browser execution is the safe system oracle
browser_action: Select an existing ACTIVE test source and execute SELECT 1
browser_expected: Visible SUCCEEDED result; one constant row; bounded execution metadata; no credential or result persisted outside current page
risk: Primary read-only journey blocked by unavailable matching KEK; product mishandles the blocker as a generic error
notes: Three attempts returned HTTP 200/application code 500; no result rows were shown

requirement_source: QRY-005; AUD-001; docs/06 failure-closed parser rule
journey: Reject an invalid non-mutating statement before target execution
preconditions: same ACTIVE test source; payload is intentionally invalid and non-mutating
api_action: Browser owns the authenticated validation; no non-secret authenticated shell harness is available
api_expected: NOT RUN: browser execution is the safe system oracle
browser_action: Submit THIS IS NOT SQL and inspect terminal status/error code
browser_expected: Visible REJECTED/failed-closed state with QUERY_PARSE_FAILED or equivalent stable code; no result rows and no target-side write
risk: Unknown syntax must fail closed and remain actionable
notes: Observed REJECTED, QUERY_PARSE_FAILED, zero rows and zero bytes; target-side zero-execution was not independently instrumented

journey: Cancel a completed or running query idempotently
preconditions: a terminal executionNo from ST-QRY-003 is visible

api_expected: NOT RUN: Edge network and visible feedback are required
browser_action: Click 取消 for the visible terminal execution number

notes: Four attempts sent POST and were rejected as unsupported; no visible success or stable error feedback
